name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Mushroom Gravy & Mashed Potatoes

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
0.681 kg white mushrooms
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and quarter the potatoes; transfer to a small saucepan.
Cover the potatoes with hot water (from the tap); bring to a boil over high heat.
Thinly slice the mushrooms and transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into 6-mm pieces) and add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms and onion.

Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, reduce the heat to medium and cook until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife, 15 to 20 minutes. Once done, reserve about 1 ½ cup of liquid and drain the rest. Cover the saucepan to keep warm.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the pork chops in the skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate, reserving the juices in the skillet.

Once the pork cutlets have been transferred, add butter to the skillet followed by the mushrooms, onions, and garlic; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables have softened, 5 to 7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the mushroom mixture cooks, using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Sprinkle the flour over the mushroom mixture and stir until it has been absorbed.
Add the broth and about ¾ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet. Cook the mixture until the gravy is thickened, another 3 to 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 710 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Add ½ of the reserved liquid, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth. Add more liquid to thin out the mash if needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, spoon the mashed potatoes onto a plate, place a pork chop on the side, top with the mushroom gravy, and sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!
